c0f84865: If input is a question mark, go to the question/selection routine. If input begins with an up-arrow, execute the InputData transform and branch to the DIE17 routine.
5be015a2: If input is an at-sign, execute the InputData transform and branch to the DIE2^Z routine.
9ece8fcd: If input is a space, the data value is date/numeric, the USER LAST EDITED in ^DISV global exists, and the data value is not date or set of codes, write the data value.

1321dd58: If data value matches the prompt string, execute the data input code ('S') and write the external value if no word-processing fields exist for the current data quality variable. Otherwise, branch to the M^DIE17 routine if data value is a word-processing field, the ^DIE3 routine if data value is a MUMPS code, or the DIEZIS^DIEZIS(DP,DIFLD,12.1) input transform routine.

16b28686: Loop through each semicolon piece of the prompt string. If the data value matches, execute the data input code ('S') and quit the loop. If no match is found, write the literal value portion of the prompt string preceding the data value and set the data value to the next semicolon piece.

27be9a37: Write the literal value portion of the prompt string following the data value if no word-processing fields exist for the current data quality variable. Set the data value to the next semicolon piece.
